full_text_en:
Xincheng Chengxin Sales Department v. Huayushan Railway Station
— Dispute over Railway Cargo Transport Contract

Plaintiff: Xincheng Chengxin Sales Department, Hohhot City, Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region.
Legal Representative: Su Shixiong, Manager.
Defendant: Huayushan Railway Station, Nanjing Railway Sub-administration.
Legal Representative: Ye Siyuan, Stationmaster.

The plaintiff, Xincheng Chengxin Sales Department, filed a lawsuit with the Nanjing Railway Transport Court against the defendant, Huayushan Railway Station, regarding a dispute over a railway cargo transport contract.

Plaintiff's Allegations: The plaintiff purchased 34,650 kg of sunflower seeds at RMB 1.76 per kg, totaling 770 packages, and entrusted Hohhot Railway Station Passenger and Cargo Service Company to transport them to Wuhu West Station under the defendant’s jurisdiction, for delivery to the consignee, Wuhu Fruit and Grocery Company, Anhui Province. Upon unloading at the destination station, the consignee detected a strong odor in the railcar and refused to accept the goods. The plaintiff thereby suffered economic losses and demanded full compensation of RMB 68,179.50, covering the value of the goods, packaging costs, and freight charges.

Defendant's Defense: The defendant acknowledged the presence of an odor in the railcar carrying the plaintiff’s goods. However, upon inspection by the health and quarantine authorities, it was determined that only the packaging materials of the goods were contaminated, while the goods themselves were not. Therefore, no loss of goods occurred. The defendant agreed to compensate for the actual loss of the contaminated packaging sacks but denied liability for any other damages.

The Nanjing Railway Transport Court found the following facts upon trial: On November 3, 1990, the plaintiff entrusted Hohhot Railway Station Passenger and Cargo Service Company to ship 34,650 kg (770 packages) of sunflower seeds as less-than-carload (LCL) freight. After acceptance of the consignment, Hohhot Railway Station loaded the goods into railcar No. 637281 on the same day. On November 9, 1990, the railcar arrived at Wuhu West Station. That same day, under the supervision of the station’s duty freight agent, the consignee, Wuhu Fruit and Grocery Company, came to take delivery. During unloading, a strong odor emanated from the railcar, causing dizziness among the dockworkers. In view of this, the consignee refused to accept the goods and reported the matter to the Wuhu Railway Health and Quarantine Station. After an on-site inspection, the Wuhu Railway Health and Quarantine Station concluded that the goods might have been contaminated, and therefore sealed all the goods and sent samples to the Food Hygiene Supervision and Inspection Institute of the Ministry of Health for examination. The examination results were as follows: The residue inside the railcar contained 3911 (a highly toxic pesticide) at a concentration of 3,591.66 mg/kg; the sacks containing the sunflower seeds also contained 3911 at a concentration of 100 mg/kg. A trace-back investigation by the railway authorities revealed that the same railcar had been used to transport 3911 on October 18, 1990. After unloading, the railcar was sent back to Zhengzhou East Station for washing and disinfection before being put back into service. Prior to being used for this shipment of sunflower seeds, the railcar had been emptied several times and had been used twice to carry cement.

The court also found that the plaintiff's claimed purchase price of RMB 1.76 per kg for the sunflower seeds was inaccurate; the actual purchase price was RMB 1.64 per kg.

During the litigation, the defendant subjected the sunflower seeds, which had been refused by the consignee, to stringent edible processing as required by the health and quarantine authorities. Thereafter, the defendant sold the goods in accordance with the *Measures for Handling Goods That Cannot Be Delivered at Ports and Stations* promulgated by the former State Economic Commission, recovering proceeds of RMB 42,770.

Opinion of the Court: The Nanjing Railway Transport Court held that the direct cause of the contamination of the goods’ packaging was the inadequate washing and disinfection of the railcar by Zhengzhou East Railway Station after it had been used to transport highly toxic pesticides, and the use of a railcar with an obvious odor to ship sunflower seeds by Hohhot Railway Station. Liability rests with the carrier under the railway cargo transport contract. Huayushan Railway Station, as the supervisory authority for Wuhu West Station and the entity that handled the plaintiff’s claim for compensation on behalf of the carrier, shall bear the liability for compensation. Pursuant to Article 41, paragraph 1, subparagraph 1, item 3 of the *Economic Contract Law of the PRC*, the carrier shall compensate for the contamination of goods during transport based on the actual loss of the goods (including packaging costs and freight charges). How should the actual loss in this case be determined?

The consignee’s refusal to accept the goods was reasonable when the goods were unloaded from a railcar with a strong odor and the cause and extent of the odor could not be immediately ascertained. Although it was later determined that the contamination only affected the packaging sacks and not the sunflower seeds themselves, the consignee’s continued refusal to accept the goods—insisting, for personal safety, that the goods could only be consumed after undergoing rigorous edible processing as required by the health authorities—was also reasonable. Accordingly, the actual loss in this case shall be calculated based on the plaintiff’s expenditure for the purchase price of the sunflower seeds, packaging costs, and freight charges, and the defendant shall compensate for that loss. The defendant’s argument that the actual loss consisted only of the contaminated sacks is untenable.

Having ascertained the facts, clarified the rights and wrongs, and determined the liability, the Nanjing Railway Transport Court presided over mediation, and the plaintiff and defendant voluntarily reached the following agreement on April 12, 1991:

The defendant, Huayushan Railway Station, shall (1) return to the plaintiff the proceeds of RMB 42,770 from the sale of the processed sunflower seeds, and (2) additionally compensate the plaintiff for economic losses in the amount of RMB 20,330.40. The total compensation to the plaintiff for economic losses shall be RMB 63,100.40.
